[chapter id="ch02-ringo" title="Chapter 2 - Shrine Morning (apple candy)"]
[bg file="bg/shrine.png"]
[ch file="ch/jolly.png" pos="left"]
[text]Next morning. Hillside shrine in soft snow-light. The apple candy survived the night in Jolly's paw.[/text]
[text speaker="Jolly"]The apple candy is still shiny! I saved half for this morning.[/text]
[text speaker="Jolly"]The shrine is so quiet after the festival. Should I make a wish, or follow the pawprints in the snow?[/text]
[choose id="shrine-choice"]
[option id="wish" label="Clap and make a wish at the shrine"]Make a wish.[/option]
[option id="prints" label="Follow the tiny pawprints"]Follow the pawprints.[/option]
[/choose]
[label id="after-wish"]
[text speaker="Jolly"]I wished for another festival... and for this candy to never melt![/text]
[text]The shrine bell rings once, far away. Jolly bows, very round and very serious.[/text]
[goto stub-end]
[label id="after-prints"]
[text speaker="Jolly"]These pawprints are exactly my size. Did I walk in a circle in my sleep?[/text]
[text]The pawprints lead in a perfect loop around the stone lantern and back to Jolly's feet.[/text]
[label id="stub-end"]
[text speaker="Jolly"]Stub Chapter 2 complete. The generated version adds fresh art and beats. (The End)[/text]
[end]
